Hello! Here is our anticipated release timeline for Dataverse 6.13:

  • Community PR Last Call: 2026-11-19
  • Core PR Last Call: 2026-11-26
  • Code Freeze: 2026-12-03
  • Curation Team Review: 2026-12-07
  • Release Date: 2026-12-16

As a reminder, "last call" means that if your open pull request doesn't have the 6.13 milestone on it and you want it to, please let us know! No guarantees! We can try to accommodate you.

Here's a handy link to open pull requests: https://github.com/IQSS/dataverse/pulls
